name: GPI Order Intake
brief: Sandbox-gated Business Central authority for GPI Order Intake
description: Creates validated draft sales orders through standard Business Central Sales Header and Sales Line validation. Phase 0 is hard-pinned to PRE_GAMERDOCS_CUTOVER_20260831 and AITEST external document numbers. Version 0.1.0.11 preserves the 0.1.0.8 resolver/create behavior, retains all 0.1.0.9-0.1.0.10 read-only identity/history diagnostics, and extends the read-only Sales Order API with requested/promised delivery, ship-to, shipment-method, shipping-agent/service, shipping-time, and outbound warehouse handling-time fields so customer-PO date semantics can be proven from Business Central without changing the write authority.
